remix_prompt: Trivia. A satirical game inspired by Futurama built around meme quiz play, with meme, creative, free game energy, study break session design, search-friendly hooks like meme quiz, trivia, quiz, aesthetics like popcore, glittercore, glitchcore, and meme-tone cues such as rizz, labubu. Designed for one-thumb mobile play with touch-friendly interactions, responsive readability, fast onboarding, and portrait-first UX tuned for iOS and Android in the 4:7 to 9:16 range.
